summary.text: Thomas Lavigne is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 148 and is a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Lavigne has represented District 148 since 2022 and is a real estate broker, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Thomas Lavigne lives in Berwick, Maine, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as owning and working as principal broker of Keay Brook Associates.
Lavigne won District 148 in 2022, defeating Margaret Wheeler, and won re-election in 2024 over Tristan Lozuaway-McComsey.
He served on the Taxation Committee in 2023-2024.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey he said he has served two terms on the Joint Standing Committee on Taxation and on the Commission to Prevent Mortgage and Deed Fraud.

He listed lower taxes and energy costs, restoring a 2% annual cap on municipal taxes, and education spending priorities among his campaign messages, and named taxes, preventing MaineCare fraud and sustainable budgeting as areas of policy interest.
His 2026 general election opponent is Democrat Marissa Tasker.
